Author: Jacob5800
Name: Retainer Pricer
Description: Price eligible retainer listings with live marketboard or Universalis data and a configurable match or one-gil-undercut rule. Manage retainer ventures using the game's own retainer UI.
Punchline: Price listings and manage retainer ventures.
